```{r}
library(tidyverse)

dummy_data <- tibble(
  treatment = rep(c("Control", "Nephelinite", "Melilitolite"), each = 3),
  replicate = rep(1:3, times = 3),
  pH = c(
    4.7, 4.8, 4.9,
    5.3, 5.4, 5.5,
    6.0, 6.1, 6.2
  )
)

ggplot(dummy_data, aes(x = treatment, y = pH)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic()
```
